ownerDecision.question: When we agreed the 20-minute maximum, which period did you intend it to cover?
ownerDecision.description: Up to 20 minutes from finishing to dispatch, with delivery travel handled separately.

changes: Earliest finished-food boundary measured from loading start rather than customer arrival
Final holding validator uses the same kitchen boundary
Existing 20-minute loading-to-door trip bound retained under separate maxTripToDoor name
unchanged: arrival deadlines and driver conflict validation
ring, vessel, microwave and fryer capacity
atomic writer, write fences, payments, loyalty, notifications and idempotency
qualificationBasis: Prior release evidence retained for unchanged components; changed holding semantics requalified by complete source-bound backend suite, exact-basket full-day hosted replay and real staging delivery availability through the production route integration. No claim of a replay of both large customer baskets.
remaining: Exact £85.50 basket contents are required for the two-order 19:50/20:00 replay.
